info.title: v2.payment.get_income_detail
info.description: Retrieves detailed order-level income information across various income statuses for a specified time period. This API enables partners to display granular transaction-level income data consistent with Seller Center’s “Income Details” view, segmented by income status and payout stage. The API dynamically adapts data fields based on the seller’s shop type (Local or Cross Border) and the selected income status (e.g., Pending, To Release, Released).

get.description: Retrieves detailed order-level income information across various income statuses for a specified time period. This API enables partners to display granular transaction-level income data consistent with Seller Center’s “Income Details” view, segmented by income status and payout stage. The API dynamically adapts data fields based on the seller’s shop type (Local or Cross Border) and the selected income status (e.g., Pending, To Release, Released).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination token for the next set of results. Use an empty string "" for the first request.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the income reference period. This field is only used for Income Status = Released, the other statuses will display all records currently in that status. For income Status = Released, For Released → Payout released date: 1. date_to must be later than date_from 2. date range cannot exceed 14 days 3. Input must follow valid date format.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the income reference period. Must be later than date_from. This field is only used for Income Status = Released, the other statuses will display all records currently in that status. For income Status = Released, For Released → Payout released date: 1. date_to must be later than date_from 2. date range cannot exceed 14 days 3. Input must follow valid date format.

parameters.name: income_status
parameters.description: Status of Seller Income payout (Enum - Desc) Local 1 -Released 2 - Pending CB 0 - To Release 1 - Released 2 - Pending

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of income detail records to retrieve per page

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
